title.narrative: Building community resilience and delivery of essential services for post-conflict recovery in Lanao del Sur / Marawi

description.narrative: The overall objective is to achieve high community resilience, coverage of essential services for children, adolescents, and women, and positive family and community behaviours in 40 conflict-affected municipalities of Lanao del Sur province and 4 adjacent areas of influence.The specific objectives of the contract are:- Quality maternal, neonatal, child and adolescent health, nutrition, water and sanitation services for all children and women, and essential knowledge attitudes and behaviours practiced, including during humanitarian crises- Early childhood education and basic education services (including alternative learning) for all children and adolescents, including during humanitarian crises- Child protection/social welfare system empowers and protects at-risk children, adolescents, and youth, including during humanitarian crises- Child-friendly provincial and municipal planning and investment for childrens rights and reduced disaster risks
